display.purpose: Prata Didone. One per page, hero headline only, centred on the plate's symmetry axis, capped at 18ch with text-balance.

headline.purpose: Prata at 1.25rem above a hairline-ruled block.

title.purpose: Prata at 1.125rem — the name of a destination in the editorial index.

bodySmall.purpose: Faustina. The sentence under an index entry, capped at 68ch.

data.purpose: Mono with tabular numerals. Damage figures, counts, any column of numbers. Mono appears ONLY where the content is a measurement.

shadows.name: plate-lift
shadows.purpose: Alpha wolf only. Atmosphere, not elevation — seats the specimen on the ground without drawing an edge.

shadows.name: eye-glow
shadows.purpose: The alpha's irises. The only lit thing on the plate.

shadows.name: ring-focus
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on the /ai scrubber thumb. No other component uses a box-shadow.

motion.name: ease-emerge
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for the one authored moment: the pack surfacing behind the alpha.

motion.name: duration-surface
motion.purpose: Length of the wolf-surface reveal (opacity + blur + mask together).

motion.name: stagger-pack
motion.purpose: Per-wolf animation delay, near pair outward to the far single.

motion.name: ease-considered
motion.purpose: Deliberate-reading surfaces (/ai methodology scrubber): 320ms state changes, 420ms for the lit rail, 160ms on the thumb.

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Default colour transition on every hover. Colour only — nothing lifts, scales or moves.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; final opacity and blur retained
motion.purpose: The pack renders already-surfaced rather than being removed. Motion is removed; content never is.

components.description: The signature: an alpha present on arrival, five pack members surfacing behind her out of blur and a lifting mask. Filled tapering forms, mirrored from one authored half.
components.css: .ds-wolf-stage { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; background: #0d1117; } .ds-wolf-stage svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; } .ds-wolf-alpha { position: absolute; inset: 0; filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 42px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)); } .ds-wolf-ink { fill: #e8e2d4; stroke: none; } .ds-wolf-ink2 { fill: #e8e2d4; stroke: none; opacity: 0.75; } .ds-wolf-eye { fill: #d29922; stroke: none; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 9px rgba(210,153,34,0.75)); } .ds-wolf-packmember { position: absolute; transform: translateX(-50%); opacity: 0; filter: blur(6px); -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, transparent 0%, #000 62%); mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, transparent 0%, #000 62%); animation: ds-wolf-surface 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards; } @keyframes ds-wolf-surface { from { opacity: 0; filter: blur(6px); } to { opacity: var(--wolf-o, 0.46); filter: blur(var(--wolf-b, 1.1px)); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-wolf-packmember { animation: none; opacity: var(--wolf-o, 0.46); filter: blur(var(--wolf-b, 1.1px)); } }

narrative.northStar: The Engraved Specimen Plate, Inverted onto Night
narrative.overview:
A nineteenth-century natural-history plate — bone-white line, symmetric frontal subject, hairline rules, no colour but the one that matters — printed in negative on the near-black ground the audience is already staring at. The wolf is drawn as a specimen rather than a logo, because the product's claim is that this guild instruments itself, and the wolf is the first thing it measured. Below the plate, the page stops being a plate and becomes a ledger: named bosses, real timestamps, real damage figures.

Density is editorial, not dashboard. Content sits on horizontal hairline rules in a single column; there are no filled cards on the landing surface and no boxes drawn around prose. The register is quiet — bone line on night ground, one gold — with all of the page's tension held in a single accent and a single authored motion.

Dark-only, and this is not a stylistic default. The audience reads this at night, on a second monitor, beside a dark EverQuest client, and every other surface of the platform is dark. There is no light theme in the build and none should be added.
keyCharacteristics: Bone line (#e8e2d4) on night ground (#0d1117); one reserved gold.
Prata for the plate voice, Faustina for prose, mono only for measurement.
Hairline rules and editorial indexes — never a grid of identical cards.
Hand-authored SVG artwork; no raster, no stock, no emoji.
Exactly one authored motion on the page; everything else is a colour fade.
Type is centred on the plate's symmetry axis in the hero, flush-left below it.

rules.name: The Reserved Gold Rule
rules.body: #d29922 is spoken for. It belongs to three things and nothing else: the wolf's eyes, values that came from the live database, and the surface responding to the user's pointer or keyboard (hover, focus, selection, caret). Audit test: cover the gold on a screen — if anything decorative disappears, it was wrong.

rules.name: The Blue Stays Outside Rule
rules.body: Blue is platform chrome. Inside an editorial column, links carry no colour and no underline at rest; they announce themselves by going gold under the pointer.

rules.name: The Status-Colour Firewall Rule
rules.body: Green/red/orange/purple mean a state in the data. Never use one to make a heading interesting.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Measurement Rule
rules.body: Mono appears where the content is a measurement — damage, counts, durations, timestamps, tabular columns — and nowhere else. Mono as a costume for 'this is technical' is out. Any number in a column that a reader will compare to the number above it also takes .tnum.

rules.name: The One Display Line Rule
rules.body: Prata is set once at display size per page. Everything else it touches is a short heading. It is a headline face, not a body face, and it is never set below ~1.1rem.

rules.name: The Prose Measure Rule
rules.body: Prose is capped by ch, not by container width: 58ch for a lead, 68ch for a supporting line, 18ch for a display headline.

rules.name: The Hairline Index Rule
rules.body: A list of destinations is an editorial index on hairline rules: icon, name, one sentence. It is never a grid of same-size cards with an icon, a heading and a paragraph in each.

rules.name: The Axis Rule
rules.body: Type that sits under a symmetric, frontal object is centred on that object's axis. Everything below the plate returns to flush left.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. If something needs to separate from what is behind it, give it a hairline or a tonal step, not a shadow. Hard offset shadows are not part of this world at any size.

rules.name: The Authored-Mark Rule
rules.body: Artwork on this system is drawn in code as SVG path data and committed. No raster hero images, no stock photography, no generated imagery — and no image-generation capability exists in this build environment, so a design that needs a bitmap cannot ship.

rules.name: The Mirror Rule
rules.body: Anything symmetric is authored once and mirrored. Symmetry is a property of the source, not a thing to be maintained by hand.

rules.name: The One Authored Moment Rule
rules.body: A page gets exactly one piece of real motion. Here it is the pack surfacing. Everything else is a 150ms colour transition on hover. The hero never assembles itself.

rules.name: The Reduced-Motion-Keeps-Content Rule
rules.body: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the pack renders already surfaced at its final opacity and blur — it is not removed. Motion is removed; content never is.

rules.name: The Emerge-Don't-Fade Rule
rules.body: Something arriving from depth resolves blur and lifts a mask as well as gaining opacity. Opacity alone reads as a fade, not as distance.

dos: Do build every new surface dark on #0d1117. There is no light theme.
Do reserve #d29922 for the wolf's eyes, live data values, and interaction state (hover / focus / selection / caret).
Do pair Prata for headings with Faustina for prose, and set the font variable explicitly rather than inheriting the body default.
Do use mono only where the content is a measurement, with .tnum on any figure that sits in a column.
Do separate sections with a border-t hairline at 70% and rows at 40%, and drop the last row's rule.
Do cap prose by measure (58ch lead, 68ch supporting, 18ch display).
Do draw new icons into the same 20x20 grid at stroke 1.5 with round caps, fill: none, stroke: currentColor — and draw new plate artwork as filled tapering forms, never as uniform-width strokes.
Do hover a whole row as one gesture with group-hover, moving icon and name to gold together.
Do give reduced-motion users the finished composition, not an emptier one.
donts: Don't add a light theme, or a prefers-color-scheme: light branch.
Don't build a grid of same-size cards each carrying an icon, a heading and a paragraph. Use the hairline index.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow line above a heading. The build has none; headings start at the heading.
Don't use emoji as an icon on any editorial surface — draw it.
Don't add shadows to surfaces. Depth is tonal steps and hairlines.
Don't ship a raster image as artwork. Draw it as SVG path data, mirrored from one half if it is symmetric.
Don't animate the hero in. The primary message is present on first paint.
Don't spend gold on decoration, or spend a status colour on anything that is not a state in the data.
Don't set prose in mono because the subject is technical.
Don't put a coloured, underlined link inside an editorial column; links there are undecorated and resolve to gold on hover.
